pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which tone does mǎ (horse) have? (1 mark)
   A. The second tone, which rises
   B. The first tone, which is flat
   C. The third tone, which dips and rises
   D. The fourth tone, which falls

2. What does 眼睛看 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The ears hear
   B. The mouth speaks
   C. The hands write
   D. The eyes see

3. Which Chinese word means "below"? (1 mark)
   A. 东西 dōngxi
   B. 门 mén
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 下面 xiàmiàn

4. What does 去 (qù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Church
   B. Mosque
   C. Yesterday
   D. To go

5. What does 浴室 (yùshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sofa
   B. Where
   C. Bathroom
   D. Below

6. What does 猫 (māo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bathroom
   B. Window
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Cat

7. Which sentence means "Happy birthday to you!"? (1 mark)
   A. 我们唱歌。
   B. 你生日是几月几号?
   C. 我的生日是三月五号。
   D. 祝你生日快乐!

8. What is a reading journal for? (1 mark)
   A. Storing food
   B. Playing games only
   C. Listing chores
   D. Keeping words and sentences you have learnt

9. What does 七 (qī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Five
   C. Seven
   D. Ten

10. Which sentence means "My birthday is on 5 March."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 我的生日是三月五号。
   C. 你生日是几月几号?
   D. 朋友送我礼物。

11. What does 两 liǎng mean in 两只眼睛? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. One
   C. Three
   D. Big

12. What does 两 (liǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two (before a counting word)
   B. Nose
   C. Foot
   D. Tooth

13. Which sentence means "Where is the television?"? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室里有床。
   B. 电视在哪儿?
   C. 床在卧室。
   D. 沙发在门旁边。

14. What does 咖啡 (kāfēi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To eat
   B. Lunch
   C. Coffee
   D. Dinner

15. Which stroke is written first in 左? (1 mark)
   A. 撇 piě
   B. 横 héng
   C. 点 diǎn
   D. 竖 shù

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My friend gives me a gift." (3 marks)

17. Give three tips for reading aloud clearly in Mandarin. (3 marks)

18. Name the three parts of a Mandarin syllable. (2 marks)

19. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." (2 marks)

20. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 窗户 and 大家. (2 marks)

21. Read and translate the chant line: 风来了,雨来了,雪也来了。 (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — The third tone, which dips and rises
   The mark ǎ is a small V, which is the dipping third tone.

2. D — The eyes see
   眼睛 is eyes and 看 is to see.

3. D — 下面 xiàmiàn
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

4. D — To go
   去 (qù) means to go.

5. C — Bathroom
   浴室 (yùshì) means bathroom.

6. D — Cat
   猫 (māo) means cat.

7. D — 祝你生日快乐!
   祝你生日快乐! (zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!) means "Happy birthday to you!".

8. D — Keeping words and sentences you have learnt
   A journal helps you review and check your progress.

9. C — Seven
   七 (qī) means seven.

10. B — 我的生日是三月五号。
   我的生日是三月五号。 (wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.) means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

11. A — Two
   两 is two when counting things.

12. A — Two (before a counting word)
   两 (liǎng) means two (before a counting word).

13. B — 电视在哪儿?
   电视在哪儿? (diànshì zài nǎr?) means "Where is the television?".

14. C — Coffee
   咖啡 (kāfēi) means coffee.

15. B — 横 héng
   左 begins with the horizontal stroke.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the whole line first; find the tones; read slowly and clearly; pause at punctuation; speak loudly enough for everyone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: An initial, a final and a tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two parts and 1 mark for all three.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 窗户: chuānghu, window. 大家: dàjiā, everybody.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fēng lái le, yǔ lái le, xuě yě lái le. The wind has come, the rain has come, the snow has come too.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 2 marks for meaning.
